description.value:
You suffuse a creature with destabilizing dark energy that tears apart molecular bonds and prevents regeneration.

Choose a creature within 60 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-warp] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[void]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[void]] damage and @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d4[persistent,void]] damage. The target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Warp damage also deals 1.5× damage to Biotic Barriers.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[void]] damage. If the target has an active Biotic Barrier, it detonates in a dark energy explosion (2d6 void in a 10-foot burst).

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
